## Notes

- We migrated from our previous helpdesk in July 2026. The old vendor's data was deleted on August 31, 2026 (certificate of deletion on file).
- Support must not attach event payloads, credentials or encryption keys to tickets. Ask customers for field names and counts instead.
- If the DPA is still unsigned when the exception lapses, Support Operations must either get the exception renewed or move ticket intake back to email.
- Not to be confused with Hollowell (our office cleaning vendor), which has no access to systems.
